units.samhita: tvaṁ vanebhyas tvam oṣadhībhyas tvaṁ nṛṇāṁ nṛpate jāyase śuciḥ ||
tava praśāstraṁ tvam adhvarīyasi brahmā cāsi gṛhapatiś ca no dame ||
tvam brahmā rayivid brahmaṇas pate tvaṁ vidhartaḥ sacase puraṁdhyā ||
tvam aryamā satpatir yasya sambhujaṁ tvam aṁśo vidathe deva bhājayuḥ ||
tvam āśuhemā rariṣe svaśvyaṁ tvaṁ narāṁ śardho asi purūvasuḥ ||
tvaṁ vātair aruṇair yāsi śaṁgayas tvam pūṣā vidhataḥ pāsi nu tmanā ||
tvam bhago nṛpate vasva īśiṣe tvam pāyur dame yas te 'vidhat ||
tvaṁ viśvāni svanīka patyase tvaṁ sahasrāṇi śatā daśa prati ||
tvam putro bhavasi yas te 'vidhat tvaṁ sakhā suśevaḥ pāsy ādhṛṣaḥ ||
tvaṁ vi bhāsy anu dakṣi dāvane tvaṁ viśikṣur asi yajñam ātaniḥ ||
tvam iḻā śatahimāsi dakṣase tvaṁ vṛtrahā vasupate sarasvatī ||
tvaṁ vājaḥ prataraṇo bṛhann asi tvaṁ rayir bahulo viśvatas pṛthuḥ ||
tvāṁ rātiṣāco adhvareṣu saścire tve devā havir adanty āhutam ||
tvayā martāsaḥ svadanta āsutiṁ tvaṁ garbho vīrudhāṁ jajñiṣe śuciḥ ||
pṛkṣo yad atra mahinā vi te bhuvad anu dyāvāpṛthivī rodasī ubhe ||
asmāñ ca tām̐ś ca pra hi neṣi vasya ā bṛhad vadema vidathe suvīrāḥ ||
samidhānaṁ suprayasaṁ svarṇaraṁ dyukṣaṁ hotāraṁ vṛjaneṣu dhūrṣadam ||
diva ived aratir mānuṣā yugā kṣapo bhāsi puruvāra saṁyataḥ ||
ratham iva vedyaṁ śukraśociṣam agnim mitraṁ na kṣitiṣu praśaṁsyam ||
pṛśnyāḥ pataraṁ citayantam akṣabhiḥ pātho na pāyuṁ janasī ubhe anu ||
hiriśipro vṛdhasānāsu jarbhurad dyaur na stṛbhiś citayad rodasī anu ||
ā naḥ kṛṇuṣva suvitāya rodasī agne havyā manuṣo deva vītaye ||
prācī dyāvāpṛthivī brahmaṇā kṛdhi sva1r ṇa śukram uṣaso vi didyutaḥ ||
hotrābhir agnir manuṣaḥ svadhvaro rājā viśām atithiś cārur āyave ||
duhānā dhenur vṛjaneṣu kārave tmanā śatinam pururūpam iṣaṇi ||
asmākaṁ dyumnam adhi pañca kṛṣṭiṣūccā sva1r ṇa śuśucīta duṣṭaram ||
yam agne yajñam upayanti vājino nitye toke dīdivāṁsaṁ sve dame ||
vasvo rāyaḥ puruścandrasya bhūyasaḥ prajāvataḥ svapatyasya śagdhi naḥ ||
asmāñ ca tām̐ś ca pra hi neṣi vasya ā bṛhad vadema vidathe suvīrāḥ ||
hotā pāvakaḥ pradivaḥ sumedhā devo devān yajatv agnir arhan ||
ghṛtapruṣā manasā havyam undan mūrdhan yajñasya sam anaktu devān ||
sa ā vaha marutāṁ śardho acyutam indraṁ naro barhiṣadaṁ yajadhvam ||
ghṛtenāktaṁ vasavaḥ sīdatedaṁ viśve devā ādityā yajñiyāsaḥ ||
vyacasvatīr vi prathantām ajuryā varṇam punānā yaśasaṁ suvīram ||
tantuṁ tataṁ saṁvayantī samīcī yajñasya peśaḥ sudughe payasvatī ||
devān yajantāv ṛtuthā sam añjato nābhā pṛthivyā adhi sānuṣu triṣu ||
tisro devīḥ svadhayā barhir edam acchidram pāntu śaraṇaṁ niṣadya ||
prajāṁ tvaṣṭā vi ṣyatu nābhim asme athā devānām apy etu pāthaḥ ||
tridhā samaktaṁ nayatu prajānan devebhyo daivyaḥ śamitopa havyam ||
anuṣvadham ā vaha mādayasva svāhākṛtaṁ vṛṣabha vakṣi havyam ||
mitra iva yo didhiṣāyyo bhūd deva ādeve jane jātavedāḥ ||
eṣa viśvāny abhy astu bhūmā devānām agnir aratir jīrāśvaḥ ||
sa dīdayad uśatīr ūrmyā ā dakṣāyyo yo dāsvate dama ā ||
vi yo bharibhrad oṣadhīṣu jihvām atyo na rathyo dodhavīti vārān ||
sa citreṇa cikite raṁsu bhāsā jujurvām̐ yo muhur ā yuvā bhūt ||
kṛṣṇādhvā tapū raṇvaś ciketa dyaur iva smayamāno nabhobhiḥ ||
agniḥ śociṣmām̐ atasāny uṣṇan kṛṣṇavyathir asvadayan na bhūma ||
asme agne saṁyadvīram bṛhantaṁ kṣumantaṁ vājaṁ svapatyaṁ rayiṁ dāḥ ||
suvīrāso abhimātiṣāhaḥ smat sūribhyo gṛṇate tad vayo dhāḥ ||
prayakṣañ jenyaṁ vasu śakema vājino yamam ||
manuṣvad daivyam aṣṭamam potā viśvaṁ tad invati ||
pari viśvāni kāvyā nemiś cakram ivābhavat ||
vidvām̐ asya vratā dhruvā vayā ivānu rohate ||
kuvit tisṛbhya ā varaṁ svasāro yā idaṁ yayuḥ ||
tāsām adhvaryur āgatau yavo vṛṣṭīva modate ||
stomaṁ yajñaṁ cād araṁ vanemā rarimā vayam ||
ayam agne tve api yaṁ yajñaṁ cakṛmā vayam ||
imā u ṣu śrudhī giraḥ ||
enā sūktena sujāta ||
saparyema saparyavaḥ ||
yuyodhy a1smad dveṣāṁsi ||
sa naḥ sahasriṇīr iṣaḥ ||
yajiṣṭha hotar ā gahi ||
dūto janyeva mitryaḥ ||
ā cāsmin satsi barhiṣi ||
vaso puruspṛhaṁ rayim ||
parṣi tasyā uta dviṣaḥ ||
ati gāhemahi dviṣaḥ ||
tvaṁ ghṛtebhir āhutaḥ ||
aṣṭāpadībhir āhutaḥ ||
sahasas putro adbhutaḥ ||
yaśastamasya mīḻhuṣaḥ ||
cārupratīka āhutaḥ ||
yasya vrataṁ na mīyate ||
añjāno ajarair abhi ||
viśvā adhi śriyo dadhe ||
ariṣyantaḥ sacemahy abhi ṣyāma pṛtanyataḥ ||
adabdhavratapramatir vasiṣṭhaḥ sahasrambharaḥ śucijihvo agniḥ ||
agne tokasya nas tane tanūnām aprayucchan dīdyad bodhi gopāḥ ||
yasmād yoner udārithā yaje tam pra tve havīṁṣi juhure samiddhe ||
tvaṁ hy asi rayipatī rayīṇāṁ tvaṁ śukrasya vacaso manotā ||
kṛdhi kṣumantaṁ jaritāram agne kṛdhi patiṁ svapatyasya rāyaḥ ||
adabdho gopā uta naḥ paraspā agne dyumad uta revad didīhi ||
śriyaṁ vasāno amṛto vicetā marmṛjenyaḥ śravasya1ḥ sa vājī ||
śyāvā rathaṁ vahato rohitā votāruṣāha cakre vibhṛtraḥ ||
śiriṇāyāṁ cid aktunā mahobhir aparīvṛto vasati pracetāḥ ||
pṛthuṁ tiraścā vayasā bṛhantaṁ vyaciṣṭham annai rabhasaṁ dṛśānam ||
maryaśrīḥ spṛhayadvarṇo agnir nābhimṛśe tanvā3 jarbhurāṇaḥ ||
anūnam agniṁ juhvā vacasyā madhupṛcaṁ dhanasā johavīmi ||
imā hi tvām ūrjo vardhayanti vasūyavaḥ sindhavo na kṣarantaḥ ||
amartyaṁ cid dāsam manyamānam avābhinad ukthair vāvṛdhānaḥ ||
tubhyed etā yāsu mandasānaḥ pra vāyave sisrate na śubhrāḥ ||
śubhras tvam indra vāvṛdhāno asme dāsīr viśaḥ sūryeṇa sahyāḥ ||
uto apo dyāṁ tastabhvāṁsam ahann ahiṁ śūra vīryeṇa ||
stavā vajram bāhvor uśantaṁ stavā harī sūryasya ketū ||
vi samanā bhūmir aprathiṣṭāraṁsta parvataś cit sariṣyan ||
dūre pāre vāṇīṁ vardhayanta indreṣitāṁ dhamanim paprathan ni ||
arejetāṁ rodasī bhiyāne kanikradato vṛṣṇo asya vajrāt ||
ni māyino dānavasya māyā apādayat papivān sutasya ||
pṛṇantas te kukṣī vardhayantv itthā sutaḥ paura indram āva ||
avasyavo dhīmahi praśastiṁ sadyas te rāyo dāvane syāma ||
śuṣmintamaṁ yaṁ cākanāma devāsme rayiṁ rāsi vīravantam ||
sajoṣaso ye ca mandasānāḥ pra vāyavaḥ pānty agraṇītim ||
asmān su pṛtsv ā tarutrāvardhayo dyām bṛhadbhir arkaiḥ ||
stṛṇānāso barhiḥ pastyāvat tvotā id indra vājam agman ||
pradodhuvac chmaśruṣu prīṇāno yāhi haribhyāṁ sutasya pītim ||
apāvṛṇor jyotir āryāya ni savyataḥ sādi dasyur indra ||
asmabhyaṁ tat tvāṣṭraṁ viśvarūpam arandhayaḥ sākhyasya tritāya ||
avartayat sūryo na cakram bhinad valam indro aṅgirasvān ||
śikṣā stotṛbhyo māti dhag bhago no bṛhad vadema vidathe suvīrāḥ ||
yasya śuṣmād rodasī abhyasetāṁ nṛmṇasya mahnā sa janāsa indraḥ ||
yo antarikṣaṁ vimame varīyo yo dyām astabhnāt sa janāsa indraḥ ||
yo aśmanor antar agniṁ jajāna saṁvṛk samatsu sa janāsa indraḥ ||
śvaghnīva yo jigīvām̐l lakṣam ādad aryaḥ puṣṭāni sa janāsa indraḥ ||
so aryaḥ puṣṭīr vija ivā mināti śrad asmai dhatta sa janāsa indraḥ ||
yuktagrāvṇo yo 'vitā suśipraḥ sutasomasya sa janāsa indraḥ ||
yaḥ sūryaṁ ya uṣasaṁ jajāna yo apāṁ netā sa janāsa indraḥ ||
samānaṁ cid ratham ātasthivāṁsā nānā havete sa janāsa indraḥ ||
yo viśvasya pratimānam babhūva yo acyutacyut sa janāsa indraḥ ||
yaḥ śardhate nānudadāti śṛdhyāṁ yo dasyor hantā sa janāsa indraḥ ||
ojāyamānaṁ yo ahiṁ jaghāna dānuṁ śayānaṁ sa janāsa indraḥ ||
yo rauhiṇam asphurad vajrabāhur dyām ārohantaṁ sa janāsa indraḥ ||
yaḥ somapā nicito vajrabāhur yo vajrahastaḥ sa janāsa indraḥ ||
yasya brahma vardhanaṁ yasya somo yasyedaṁ rādhaḥ sa janāsa indraḥ ||
vayaṁ ta indra viśvaha priyāsaḥ suvīrāso vidatham ā vadema ||
tad āhanā abhavat pipyuṣī payo 'ṁśoḥ pīyūṣam prathamaṁ tad ukthyam ||
samāno adhvā pravatām anuṣyade yas tākṛṇoḥ prathamaṁ sāsy ukthyaḥ ||
viśvā ekasya vinudas titikṣate yas tākṛṇoḥ prathamaṁ sāsy ukthyaḥ ||
asinvan daṁṣṭraiḥ pitur atti bhojanaṁ yas tākṛṇoḥ prathamaṁ sāsy ukthyaḥ ||
taṁ tvā stomebhir udabhir na vājinaṁ devaṁ devā ajanan sāsy ukthyaḥ ||
sa śevadhiṁ ni dadhiṣe vivasvati viśvasyaika īśiṣe sāsy ukthyaḥ ||
yaś cāsamā ajano didyuto diva urur ūrvām̐ abhitaḥ sāsy ukthyaḥ ||
ūrjayantyā apariviṣṭam āsyam utaivādya purukṛt sāsy ukthyaḥ ||
arajjau dasyūn sam unab dabhītaye suprāvyo abhavaḥ sāsy ukthyaḥ ||
ṣaḻ astabhnā viṣṭiraḥ pañca saṁdṛśaḥ pari paro abhavaḥ sāsy ukthyaḥ ||
jātūṣṭhirasya pra vayaḥ sahasvato yā cakartha sendra viśvāsy ukthyaḥ ||
nīcā santam ud anayaḥ parāvṛjam prāndhaṁ śroṇaṁ śravayan sāsy ukthyaḥ ||
indra yac citraṁ śravasyā anu dyūn bṛhad vadema vidathe suvīrāḥ ||
kāmī hi vīraḥ sadam asya pītiṁ juhota vṛṣṇe tad id eṣa vaṣṭi ||
tasmā etam bharata tadvaśāyam̐ eṣa indro arhati pītim asya ||
tasmā etam antarikṣe na vātam indraṁ somair orṇuta jūr na vastraiḥ ||
yo arbudam ava nīcā babādhe tam indraṁ somasya bhṛthe hinota ||
yaḥ pipruṁ namuciṁ yo rudhikrāṁ tasmā indrāyāndhaso juhota ||
yo varcinaḥ śatam indraḥ sahasram apāvapad bharatā somam asmai ||
kutsasyāyor atithigvasya vīrān ny āvṛṇag bharatā somam asmai ||
gabhastipūtam bharata śrutāyendrāya somaṁ yajyavo juhota ||
juṣāṇo hastyam abhi vāvaśe va indrāya somam madiraṁ juhota ||
vedāham asya nibhṛtam ma etad ditsantam bhūyo yajataś ciketa ||
tam ūrdaraṁ na pṛṇatā yavenendraṁ somebhis tad apo vo astu ||
indra yac citraṁ śravasyā anu dyūn bṛhad vadema vidathe suvīrāḥ ||
trikadrukeṣv apibat sutasyāsya made ahim indro jaghāna ||
sa dhārayat pṛthivīm paprathac ca somasya tā mada indraś cakāra ||
vṛthāsṛjat pathibhir dīrghayāthaiḥ somasya tā mada indraś cakāra ||
saṁ gobhir aśvair asṛjad rathebhiḥ somasya tā mada indraś cakāra ||
ta utsnāya rayim abhi pra tasthuḥ somasya tā mada indraś cakāra ||
ajavaso javinībhir vivṛścan somasya tā mada indraś cakāra ||
prati śroṇaḥ sthād vy a1nag acaṣṭa somasya tā mada indraś cakāra ||
riṇag rodhāṁsi kṛtrimāṇy eṣāṁ somasya tā mada indraś cakāra ||
rambhī cid atra vivide hiraṇyaṁ somasya tā mada indraś cakāra ||
śikṣā stotṛbhyo māti dhag bhago no bṛhad vadema vidathe suvīrāḥ ||
indram ajuryaṁ jarayantam ukṣitaṁ sanād yuvānam avase havāmahe ||
jaṭhare somaṁ tanvī3 saho maho haste vajram bharati śīrṣaṇi kratum ||
na te vajram anv aśnoti kaś cana yad āśubhiḥ patasi yojanā puru ||
vṛṣā yajasva haviṣā viduṣṭaraḥ pibendra somaṁ vṛṣabheṇa bhānunā ||
vṛṣaṇādhvaryū vṛṣabhāso adrayo vṛṣaṇaṁ somaṁ vṛṣabhāya suṣvati ||
vṛṣṇo madasya vṛṣabha tvam īśiṣa indra somasya vṛṣabhasya tṛpṇuhi ||
kuvin no asya vacaso nibodhiṣad indram utsaṁ na vasunaḥ sicāmahe ||
sakṛt su te sumatibhiḥ śatakrato sam patnībhir na vṛṣaṇo nasīmahi ||
śikṣā stotṛbhyo māti dhag bhago no bṛhad vadema vidathe suvīrāḥ ||
viśvā yad gotrā sahasā parīvṛtā made somasya dṛṁhitāny airayat ||
śūro yo yutsu tanvam parivyata śīrṣaṇi dyām mahinā praty amuñcata ||
ratheṣṭhena haryaśvena vicyutāḥ pra jīrayaḥ sisrate sadhrya1k pṛthak ||
ād rodasī jyotiṣā vahnir ātanot sīvyan tamāṁsi dudhitā sam avyayat ||
adhārayat pṛthivīṁ viśvadhāyasam astabhnān māyayā dyām avasrasaḥ ||
yenā pṛthivyāṁ ni kriviṁ śayadhyai vajreṇa hatvy avṛṇak tuviṣvaṇiḥ ||
kṛdhi praketam upa māsy ā bhara daddhi bhāgaṁ tanvo3 yena māmahaḥ ||
aviḍḍhīndra citrayā na ūtī kṛdhi vṛṣann indra vasyaso naḥ ||
śikṣā stotṛbhyo māti dhag bhago no bṛhad vadema vidathe suvīrāḥ ||
daśāritro manuṣyaḥ svarṣāḥ sa iṣṭibhir matibhī raṁhyo bhūt ||
anyasyā garbham anya ū jananta so anyebhiḥ sacate jenyo vṛṣā ||
mo ṣu tvām atra bahavo hi viprā ni rīraman yajamānāso anye ||
āṣṭābhir daśabhiḥ somapeyam ayaṁ sutaḥ sumakha mā mṛdhas kaḥ ||
ā pañcāśatā surathebhir indrā ṣaṣṭyā saptatyā somapeyam ||
ayaṁ hi te śunahotreṣu soma indra tvāyā pariṣikto madāya ||
purutrā hi vihavyo babhūthāsmiñ chūra savane mādayasva ||
upa jyeṣṭhe varūthe gabhastau prāye-prāye jigīvāṁsaḥ syāma ||
śikṣā stotṛbhyo māti dhag bhago no bṛhad vadema vidathe suvīrāḥ ||
yasminn indraḥ pradivi vāvṛdhāna oko dadhe brahmaṇyantaś ca naraḥ ||
pra yad vayo na svasarāṇy acchā prayāṁsi ca nadīnāṁ cakramanta ||
ajanayat sūryaṁ vidad gā aktunāhnāṁ vayunāni sādhat ||
sadyo yo nṛbhyo atasāyyo bhūt paspṛdhānebhyaḥ sūryasya sātau ||
ā yad rayiṁ guhadavadyam asmai bharad aṁśaṁ naitaśo daśasyan ||
divodāsāya navatiṁ ca navendraḥ puro vy airac chambarasya ||
aśyāma tat sāptam āśuṣāṇā nanamo vadhar adevasya pīyoḥ ||
brahmaṇyanta indra te navīya iṣam ūrjaṁ sukṣitiṁ sumnam aśyuḥ ||
śikṣā stotṛbhyo māti dhag bhago no bṛhad vadema vidathe suvīrāḥ ||
vipanyavo dīdhyato manīṣā sumnam iyakṣantas tvāvato nṝn ||
tvam ino dāśuṣo varūtetthādhīr abhi yo nakṣati tvā ||
yaḥ śaṁsantaṁ yaḥ śaśamānam ūtī pacantaṁ ca stuvantaṁ ca praṇeṣat ||
sa vasvaḥ kāmam pīparad iyāno brahmaṇyato nūtanasyāyoḥ ||
muṣṇann uṣasaḥ sūryeṇa stavān aśnasya cic chiśnathat pūrvyāṇi ||
ava priyam arśasānasya sāhvāñ chiro bharad dāsasya svadhāvān ||
ajanayan manave kṣām apaś ca satrā śaṁsaṁ yajamānasya tūtot ||
prati yad asya vajram bāhvor dhur hatvī dasyūn pura āyasīr ni tārīt ||
śikṣā stotṛbhyo māti dhag bhago no bṛhad vadema vidathe suvīrāḥ ||
aśvajite gojite abjite bharendrāya somaṁ yajatāya haryatam ||
tuvigraye vahnaye duṣṭarītave satrāsāhe nama indrāya vocata ||
vṛtaṁcayaḥ sahurir vikṣv ārita indrasya vocam pra kṛtāni vīryā ||
radhracodaḥ śnathano vīḻitas pṛthur indraḥ suyajña uṣasaḥ svar janat ||
abhisvarā niṣadā gā avasyava indre hinvānā draviṇāny āśata ||
poṣaṁ rayīṇām ariṣṭiṁ tanūnāṁ svādmānaṁ vācaḥ sudinatvam ahnām ||
sa īm mamāda mahi karma kartave mahām uruṁ sainaṁ saścad devo devaṁ satyam indraṁ satya induḥ ||
adhattānyaṁ jaṭhare prem aricyata sainaṁ saścad devo devaṁ satyam indraṁ satya induḥ ||
dātā rādhaḥ stuvate kāmyaṁ vasu sainaṁ saścad devo devaṁ satyam indraṁ satya induḥ ||
bhuvad viśvam abhy ādevam ojasā vidād ūrjaṁ śatakratur vidād iṣam ||
jyeṣṭharājam brahmaṇām brahmaṇas pata ā naḥ śṛṇvann ūtibhiḥ sīda sādanam ||
usrā iva sūryo jyotiṣā maho viśveṣām ij janitā brahmaṇām asi ||
bṛhaspate bhīmam amitradambhanaṁ rakṣohaṇaṁ gotrabhidaṁ svarvidam ||
brahmadviṣas tapano manyumīr asi bṛhaspate mahi tat te mahitvanam ||
viśvā id asmād dhvaraso vi bādhase yaṁ sugopā rakṣasi brahmaṇas pate ||
bṛhaspate yo no abhi hvaro dadhe svā tam marmartu ducchunā harasvatī ||
bṛhaspate apa taṁ vartayā pathaḥ sugaṁ no asyai devavītaye kṛdhi ||
bṛhaspate devanido ni barhaya mā durevā uttaraṁ sumnam un naśan ||
yā no dūre taḻito yā arātayo 'bhi santi jambhayā tā anapnasaḥ ||
mā no duḥśaṁso abhidipsur īśata pra suśaṁsā matibhis tāriṣīmahi ||
asi satya ṛṇayā brahmaṇas pata ugrasya cid damitā vīḻuharṣiṇaḥ ||
